items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Some of the concepts of thermodynamics were introduced in earlier sections, work and energy being the major ones. Here we shall look in detail at two ways of describing thermodynamic systems to proceed with our study.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall define energy for an arbitrary system as

[Source paragraph 3; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We sometimes write Equation 2.38 in its intensive form as

[Source paragraph 4; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Recall from our earlier discussions that an intensive property is the associated extensive property divided by mass.

[Source paragraph 5; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

For a fixed mass of material, undergoing some thermodynamic process, the first law of thermodynamics can be written as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

The subscript 1-2 simply lets us know that the process began at some state 1 and ends at some state 2. The signs on the terms are very important. We assume a positive change in energy comes about by adding heat to the system and doing work on the system. Thus, work performed on the system is positive and heat added is positive. Different thermodynamics texts write the first law slightly differently, but if you understand that the net result of work on the system or heat transfer to the system is to increase its energy, then few mistakes will be made.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Caution is warranted at this point. Equation 2.40 does not say how the energy, once added to the system, is partitioned between potential (internal) energy and kinetic energy. This reveals something. Heat and work are added to or removed from the system at the system boundaries while the distribution of energy between internal or kinetic energy is done within the system.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall now explicitly write out Equation 2.40 for a Lagrangian system

[Source paragraph 9; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Here we have neglected the gravitational potential energy terms and used the intensive form of the energy, multiplied by the system mass. rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

运动微分方程是牛顿第二运动定律在流体力学中的表达形式。在某些规定的条件下对运动微分方程积分就得到伯努利方程。

[Source paragraph 2; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

如果流动满足：i 流动是定常的（各参量对时间的偏导数为零）；ii 质量力是有势力；iii 流体是正压性的（密度可以只表示为压力的函数）或不可压缩，则可以将欧拉运动微分方程沿着流线积分，得：

[Source paragraph 3; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

这就是著名的伯努利方程。方程中的三项依次为单位质量流体的重力势能、动能和压力势能。伯努利方程表明，当流动满足上述一系列条件时，在同一条流线上，重力势能、动能与压力势能之总和保持为常数。伯努利方程反映了理想流体流动中的机械能守恒。

[Source paragraph 4; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

实际流体由于存在黏性，在流动会有机械能向热能的转换。也就是说，在实际流体的流动中有机械能的损失，不符合式(3.9)。

[Source paragraph 5; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

对于有限过流截面的实际流体管流，将式(3.10)在管道截面上积分平均，即得到实际流体管流的伯努利方程：

[Source paragraph 6; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

需要指出的是，运用实际流体管流的伯努利方程时，截面应选在“缓变流”处，即流体在此处无折转，截面无突然变化。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.2 Other Gas Laws; intervening text may be omitted]

Ideal gas behavior is approached when the distance between molecules (known as the mean free path) is large. Thus, molecules do not collide or interact with one another very

[Source paragraph 2; 2.2 Other Gas Laws; intervening text may be omitted]

The covolume of the gas has been described as a parameter that takes into account the physical size of the molecules and any intermolecular forces created by their proximity to one another. Think of it as not having physical meaning but as simply a number that allows for a better fit to observed experimental data. The units of the covolume are cubic length per mass unit. Usually, the gas covolume is provided in the literature, but an estimation tool has been provided by Corner [7], which will not be repeated here since actual data exist.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

运动微分方程是牛顿第二运动定律在流体力学中的表达形式。在某些规定的条件下对运动微分方程积分就得到伯努利方程。

[Source paragraph 2; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

如果流动满足：i 流动是定常的（各参量对时间的偏导数为零）；ii 质量力是有势力；iii 流体是正压性的（密度可以只表示为压力的函数）或不可压缩，则可以将欧拉运动微分方程沿着流线积分，得：

[Source paragraph 3; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

这就是著名的伯努利方程。方程中的三项依次为单位质量流体的重力势能、动能和压力势能。伯努利方程表明，当流动满足上述一系列条件时，在同一条流线上，重力势能、动能与压力势能之总和保持为常数。伯努利方程反映了理想流体流动中的机械能守恒。

[Source paragraph 4; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

实际流体由于存在黏性，在流动会有机械能向热能的转换。也就是说，在实际流体的流动中有机械能的损失，不符合式(3.9)。

[Source paragraph 5; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

对于有限过流截面的实际流体管流，将式(3.10)在管道截面上积分平均，即得到实际流体管流的伯努利方程：

[Source paragraph 6; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

需要指出的是，运用实际流体管流的伯努利方程时，截面应选在“缓变流”处，即流体在此处无折转，截面无突然变化。

# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

运动微分方程是牛顿第二运动定律在流体力学中的表达形式。在某些规定的条件下对运动微分方程积分就得到伯努利方程。

[Source paragraph 2; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

如果流动满足：i 流动是定常的（各参量对时间的偏导数为零）；ii 质量力是有势力；iii 流体是正压性的（密度可以只表示为压力的函数）或不可压缩，则可以将欧拉运动微分方程沿着流线积分，得：

[Source paragraph 3; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

这就是著名的伯努利方程。方程中的三项依次为单位质量流体的重力势能、动能和压力势能。伯努利方程表明，当流动满足上述一系列条件时，在同一条流线上，重力势能、动能与压力势能之总和保持为常数。伯努利方程反映了理想流体流动中的机械能守恒。

[Source paragraph 4; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

实际流体由于存在黏性，在流动会有机械能向热能的转换。也就是说，在实际流体的流动中有机械能的损失，不符合式(3.9)。

[Source paragraph 5; 3.2.3 运动微分方程与伯努利方程; intervening text may be omitted]

对于有限过流截面的实际流体管流，将式(3.10)在管道截面上积分平均，即得到实际流体管流的伯努利方程：

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Consider an arbitrary property  $N$  of a substance. We would like to see how this property is transported into and out of a CV. If we define an intensive property  $\eta$  such that

[Source paragraph 2; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

This equation defines how a property of interest is transported into and out of the CV. If we look at each of the terms, we see that this is an intuitively satisfying equation. The term on the LHS is the time rate of change (decrease) of any property of the CV over a time of interest. The first term on the RHS tells us how much of that property is stored in the CV over this time. The second term on the RHS tells us how much material has left the CV, while the third term tells us how much material has entered.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Now wait a minute! If we look at the signs on the second and third terms, they seem to be incorrect—should not the stuff leaving have a negative sign and the stuff entering have a positive sign? The answer to this is yes, but Equation 2.129 is written correctly. The key to this seemingly inconsistent sign convention lies in the fact that the dot product in the second term is positive when we define the area as a vector that points outward and is normal to the surface. Similarly, the inflow term will always lead to a negative number since the velocity vector points inward and the area vector points outward.

[Source paragraph 4; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The ends of this cylindrical CV are designated as CSs. The inlet side is CS1 and the outlet side is CS2. If we would like to write an equation for how mass is transferred into or out of this CV, we set  $N$ , the flow variable in Equation 2.129, equal to  $m$ , the property of interest. When this is done, Equation 2.128 tells us that

[Source paragraph 5; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

We know mass can neither be created nor destroyed, so  $\mathrm{dm} / \mathrm{dt} = 0$ , then we arrive at what is commonly called the equation of conservation of mass, or the continuity equation. In a general form, it is given as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The first term on the LHS states how the mass in the CV is changing with time. The second term is the amount of mass exiting the CV, and the third term is the amount of mass entering the CV.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Simply put, this equation states that what comes into the CV equals what goes out of the CV.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

When we apply this assumption to Equation 2.133 and note that  $\mathbf{V} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A}$  is negative at CS1 (because the vectors have opposite directions) and positive at CS2, we obtain the following simple relationship:

[Source paragraph 9; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Thus, under the steady flow assumption, the mass flow rate  $m$  is constant.

field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

We have discussed some governing equations, but let us break for a moment to discuss why a gas shocks up. If we closely examine Equation 2.170, we see that a higher pressure causes a faster motion of the wave. If we imagine a shock wave as depicted in Figure 2.27 moving to the right, we can pick out three points that we shall follow for some time. Point A is essentially the beginning of the pressure increase and at the unshocked initial pressure. Point B is at some pressure in between the peak pressure of the shock and the initial pressure of the material into which the shock is propagating. Point C is at the peak shock pressure. From Equation 2.170, we see that the local velocity of point B must be greater than point A and that the local velocity of point C is greater still. This means that at some time  $t$ , these points must converge, thereby forming a step discontinuity in pressure. This step discontinuity is the way we model the shock—there is actually a very small distance over which a shock will develop so that the pressure increase is rapid, but continuous. With this information, we see that compression shocks are the only admissible shocks. Later we will introduce rarefactions that are the converse of shocks. rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Every material exists in some physical state of either solid, liquid, or gas. There are several variables that we can directly measure and some that we cannot but that are related to one another through some functional relationship. This functional relationship varies from substance to substance and is known as an equation of state.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Thermodynamically, the number of independent properties required to define the state of a substance is given by the so-called state postulate, which is described by Wark [1]. For all the substances examined in this chapter, we shall assume that they behave in a simple manner. This essentially means that the equilibrium state of all our substances can be defined by the specification of two independent, intrinsic properties. In this sense, an intrinsic property is a property that is characteristic of (in other words, governed by) molecular behavior.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The ideal gas law is essentially a combination of three relationships [2]. Charles's law states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to its temperature. Avogadro's principle states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to the number of moles of gas present. Boyle's law states that volume is inversely proportional to pressure. If we combine these three relationships, we arrive at the famous ideal gas law, which states in extensive form

[Source paragraph 4; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The units of Equation 2.1 are not always convenient to work with. For this reason, the form of the ideal gas law that we shall use most often in this text is

[Source paragraph 5; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The specific gas constant can be determined from the universal gas constant by dividing the latter by the molar mass:

[Source paragraph 6; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

In these equations, V (nonitalicized) is the volume the gas occupies;  $m_{\mathrm{g}}$  is the mass of the gas; and  $\rho$  is the gas density.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

One should always check the units when using these equations.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The pressure in a vessel filled with gas is caused by innumerable collisions of the gas molecules on the walls of the vessel [2]. The more tightly packed the molecules are, the more collisions occur—the higher the pressure is. Similarly, temperature excites the gas molecules so that they move faster, collide more—thus also increasing pressure. It is these collisions, among other things, that must be handled somehow by our equation of state.

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Every material exists in some physical state of either solid, liquid, or gas. There are several variables that we can directly measure and some that we cannot but that are related to one another through some functional relationship. This functional relationship varies from substance to substance and is known as an equation of state.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Thermodynamically, the number of independent properties required to define the state of a substance is given by the so-called state postulate, which is described by Wark [1]. For all the substances examined in this chapter, we shall assume that they behave in a simple manner. This essentially means that the equilibrium state of all our substances can be defined by the specification of two independent, intrinsic properties. In this sense, an intrinsic property is a property that is characteristic of (in other words, governed by) molecular behavior.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The ideal gas law is essentially a combination of three relationships [2]. Charles's law states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to its temperature. Avogadro's principle states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to the number of moles of gas present. Boyle's law states that volume is inversely proportional to pressure. [Source paragraph 5; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The specific gas constant can be determined from the universal gas constant by dividing the latter by the molar mass:

[Source paragraph 6; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

In these equations, V (nonitalicized) is the volume the gas occupies;  $m_{\mathrm{g}}$  is the mass of the gas; and  $\rho$  is the gas density.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

One should always check the units when using these equations.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The pressure in a vessel filled with gas is caused by innumerable collisions of the gas molecules on the walls of the vessel [2]. The more tightly packed the molecules are, the more collisions occur—the higher the pressure is. fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。

fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Every material exists in some physical state of either solid, liquid, or gas. There are several variables that we can directly measure and some that we cannot but that are related to one another through some functional relationship. This functional relationship varies from substance to substance and is known as an equation of state.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

Thermodynamically, the number of independent properties required to define the state of a substance is given by the so-called state postulate, which is described by Wark [1]. For all the substances examined in this chapter, we shall assume that they behave in a simple manner. This essentially means that the equilibrium state of all our substances can be defined by the specification of two independent, intrinsic properties. In this sense, an intrinsic property is a property that is characteristic of (in other words, governed by) molecular behavior.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The ideal gas law is essentially a combination of three relationships [2]. Charles's law states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to its temperature. Avogadro's principle states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to the number of moles of gas present. Boyle's law states that volume is inversely proportional to pressure. If we combine these three relationships, we arrive at the famous ideal gas law, which states in extensive form

[Source paragraph 4; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The units of Equation 2.1 are not always convenient to work with. For this reason, the form of the ideal gas law that we shall use most often in this text is

[Source paragraph 5; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The specific gas constant can be determined from the universal gas constant by dividing the latter by the molar mass:

[Source paragraph 6; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

In these equations, V (nonitalicized) is the volume the gas occupies;  $m_{\mathrm{g}}$  is the mass of the gas; and  $\rho$  is the gas density.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

One should always check the units when using these equations.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.1 Ideal Gas Law; intervening text may be omitted]

The pressure in a vessel filled with gas is caused by innumerable collisions of the gas molecules on the walls of the vessel [2]. The more tightly packed the molecules are, the more collisions occur—the higher the pressure is. Similarly, temperature excites the gas molecules so that they move faster, collide more—thus also increasing pressure. It is these collisions, among other things, that must be handled somehow by our equation of state.

field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

[Source paragraph 1; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Some of the concepts of thermodynamics were introduced in earlier sections, work and energy being the major ones. Here we shall look in detail at two ways of describing thermodynamic systems to proceed with our study.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall define energy for an arbitrary system as

[Source paragraph 3; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We sometimes write Equation 2.38 in its intensive form as

[Source paragraph 4; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Recall from our earlier discussions that an intensive property is the associated extensive property divided by mass.

[Source paragraph 5; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

For a fixed mass of material, undergoing some thermodynamic process, the first law of thermodynamics can be written as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

The subscript 1-2 simply lets us know that the process began at some state 1 and ends at some state 2. The signs on the terms are very important. We assume a positive change in energy comes about by adding heat to the system and doing work on the system. Thus, work performed on the system is positive and heat added is positive. Different thermodynamics texts write the first law slightly differently, but if you understand that the net result of work on the system or heat transfer to the system is to increase its energy, then few mistakes will be made.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Caution is warranted at this point. Equation 2.40 does not say how the energy, once added to the system, is partitioned between potential (internal) energy and kinetic energy. This reveals something. Heat and work are added to or removed from the system at the system boundaries while the distribution of energy between internal or kinetic energy is done within the system.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall now explicitly write out Equation 2.40 for a Lagrangian system

[Source paragraph 9; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Here we have neglected the gravitational potential energy terms and used the intensive form of the energy, multiplied by the system mass. As previously stated many times, we would like to use enthalpies instead of internal energies. If this is the case, we can rewrite Equation 2.41 using our relationship between the two from Equation 2.40. We shall use the intensive form of Equation 2.40 to yield

[Source paragraph 10; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Here we note that  $h$  is the specific enthalpy and  $v$  is the specific volume.

[Source paragraph 11; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall now examine the first law of thermodynamics in the Eulerian frame of reference. Recall that in the Eulerian frame, we chose a CV (real or imaginary) and observed how the energy within the volume changes based upon the energy carried into or out of it by any entering or exiting substance as well as any heat or work done at the system boundaries. It is convenient for us to write the first law in terms of the time rate of change of energy, heat, and work. We start by writing Equation 2.40 as a rate equation

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

A fluid differs from a solid in its behavior when placed in shear. In general, fluids can support little or no shear loads or tensile stress. Fluids are generally characterized by their behavior under shear stress. Because a fluid will, in general, flow readily under a shear stress, this behavior is normally plotted in a graph of rate of deformation vs. shear stress as depicted in Figure 2.15.

[Source paragraph 2; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

A fluid is considered to exhibit Newtonian behavior if there is a linear relationship between shear stress and rate of deformation. A fluid is non-Newtonian otherwise. Some fluids such as an ideal plastic or a thixotropic material actually do exhibit a yield stress. In the case of an ideal plastic, after a certain yield stress is achieved, the material exhibits a linear relationship between stress and deformation rate. A thixotropic material exhibits a nonlinear relationship after yield stress is reached. An ideal fluid is one where the material will flow and continue to accelerate regardless of the amount of shear stress applied.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Many of the fluids we will deal with are Newtonian. Mathematically, the relationship between the applied shear stress and deformation rate is given by

[Source paragraph 4; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The ratio of the dynamic viscosity to the fluid density occurs so often that it is customary to define a kinematic viscosity as

[Source paragraph 5; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

In the section on thermodynamics, we introduced the concept of a Lagrangian or control mass approach and a Eulerian or CV approach to solving transport problems. In examination of the behavior of a fluid, we need to develop both of these techniques. Our plan of attack will be to develop these equations in a CV and provide equations to change the reference frame afterward. For a more complete treatment, the reader is referred to the books by Fox and McDonald [11], Anderson [12], White [25], Panton [26], Currie [27], and White [28].

[Source paragraph 6; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The basis for our development of the following equations are the tenets that (1) mass must be conserved and (2) Newton's second law must hold true. Newton's second law can be written as

[Source paragraph 7; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Since CVs can be oriented in an arbitrary manner, it is important to understand that only that component of velocity normal to the control surface (CS) (i.e., the boundary of the CV) transports material or energy into the CV. If we examine Figure 2.16 where we have broken the velocity vectors into normal and tangential components (denoted as  $V_{\mathrm{n}}$  and  $V_{\mathrm{t}}$ , respectively), we can clearly see why this is so.

If judgment_ready is false, preserve the original source opinion, keep formal mapping unassigned, and explain missing metadata. field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.

review_scope_policy.task_goal: 收录可复用的一般领域知识与保留完整条件的知识；局部约定、推导步骤和教学示例保留来源记录，不进入主图。

general.label: 一般知识
general.boundary: 在领域内可复用的事实、规律或概念定义。标准术语的通用定义归此类；不能仅因原文出现‘定义’就判为局部约定。

conditional.label: 条件性知识
conditional.boundary: 在明确条件下可复用的领域事实；必须保留条件、频率、否定和模态。不能把‘在条件下成立’等同于局部符号约定。

local_definition.label: 局部定义或符号约定
local_definition.boundary: 仅在当前章节、推导或作者语境中约定的符号、命名和临时定义；不能直接推广为领域通用事实。

derivation.label: 推导步骤
derivation.boundary: 为获得结论而采用的中间变形或证明过程。独立成立、可复用的最终定理按一般或条件性知识判断。

example.label: 教学示例
example.boundary: 仅为演示方法而设定的具体对象、数值或情形；示例之外被明确支持的一般规律可单独审核。

unresolved.label: 类别待确认
unresolved.boundary: 上下文不足、类别分歧或有效审核席位不足时保留待确认，不由模型自行决定收录或排除。

items.quote:
# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Consider an arbitrary property  $N$  of a substance. We would like to see how this property is transported into and out of a CV. If we define an intensive property  $\eta$  such that

[Source paragraph 2; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

This equation defines how a property of interest is transported into and out of the CV. If we look at each of the terms, we see that this is an intuitively satisfying equation. The term on the LHS is the time rate of change (decrease) of any property of the CV over a time of interest. The first term on the RHS tells us how much of that property is stored in the CV over this time. The second term on the RHS tells us how much material has left the CV, while the third term tells us how much material has entered.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Now wait a minute! If we look at the signs on the second and third terms, they seem to be incorrect—should not the stuff leaving have a negative sign and the stuff entering have a positive sign? The answer to this is yes, but Equation 2.129 is written correctly. The key to this seemingly inconsistent sign convention lies in the fact that the dot product in the second term is positive when we define the area as a vector that points outward and is normal to the surface. Similarly, the inflow term will always lead to a negative number since the velocity vector points inward and the area vector points outward.

[Source paragraph 4; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The ends of this cylindrical CV are designated as CSs. The inlet side is CS1 and the outlet side is CS2. If we would like to write an equation for how mass is transferred into or out of this CV, we set  $N$ , the flow variable in Equation 2.129, equal to  $m$ , the property of interest. When this is done, Equation 2.128 tells us that

[Source paragraph 5; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

We know mass can neither be created nor destroyed, so  $\mathrm{dm} / \mathrm{dt} = 0$ , then we arrive at what is commonly called the equation of conservation of mass, or the continuity equation. In a general form, it is given as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The first term on the LHS states how the mass in the CV is changing with time. The second term is the amount of mass exiting the CV, and the third term is the amount of mass entering the CV.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Simply put, this equation states that what comes into the CV equals what goes out of the CV.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

When we apply this assumption to Equation 2.133 and note that  $\mathbf{V} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A}$  is negative at CS1 (because the vectors have opposite directions) and positive at CS2, we obtain the following simple relationship:

[Source paragraph 9; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

# Descriptive concept source excerpt

[Source paragraph 1; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Consider an arbitrary property  $N$  of a substance. We would like to see how this property is transported into and out of a CV. If we define an intensive property  $\eta$  such that

[Source paragraph 2; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

This equation defines how a property of interest is transported into and out of the CV. If we look at each of the terms, we see that this is an intuitively satisfying equation. The term on the LHS is the time rate of change (decrease) of any property of the CV over a time of interest. The first term on the RHS tells us how much of that property is stored in the CV over this time. The second term on the RHS tells us how much material has left the CV, while the third term tells us how much material has entered.

[Source paragraph 3; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Now wait a minute! If we look at the signs on the second and third terms, they seem to be incorrect—should not the stuff leaving have a negative sign and the stuff entering have a positive sign? The answer to this is yes, but Equation 2.129 is written correctly. The key to this seemingly inconsistent sign convention lies in the fact that the dot product in the second term is positive when we define the area as a vector that points outward and is normal to the surface. Similarly, the inflow term will always lead to a negative number since the velocity vector points inward and the area vector points outward.

[Source paragraph 4; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The ends of this cylindrical CV are designated as CSs. The inlet side is CS1 and the outlet side is CS2. If we would like to write an equation for how mass is transferred into or out of this CV, we set  $N$ , the flow variable in Equation 2.129, equal to  $m$ , the property of interest. When this is done, Equation 2.128 tells us that

[Source paragraph 5; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

We know mass can neither be created nor destroyed, so  $\mathrm{dm} / \mathrm{dt} = 0$ , then we arrive at what is commonly called the equation of conservation of mass, or the continuity equation. In a general form, it is given as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

The first term on the LHS states how the mass in the CV is changing with time. The second term is the amount of mass exiting the CV, and the third term is the amount of mass entering the CV.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Simply put, this equation states that what comes into the CV equals what goes out of the CV.

[Source paragraph 8; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

When we apply this assumption to Equation 2.133 and note that  $\mathbf{V} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A}$  is negative at CS1 (because the vectors have opposite directions) and positive at CS2, we obtain the following simple relationship:

[Source paragraph 9; 2.7 Fluid Mechanics; intervening text may be omitted]

Thus, under the steady flow assumption, the mass flow rate  $m$  is constant.

field_spec.scope: 审核字段口径与派生规范化表达；原始候选与正式映射分别保留

fields.frequency: 命题成立的频率，如常常、总是；保留原词、强度、条件和语义附着，不等同于数量或适用条件。
fields.quantifier: 对象数量或量化范围，如至少三个、所有；分别表示对象之间的对应，不是数量。
fields.applicability: 命题适用的对象、环境或范围；频率不写在此字段。
fields.condition: 命题成立所需条件；迁移和去重不得删除或扩大条件范围。
fields.modality: 结合完整语境判断断言、假设、能力、可能性和必要性；定义或等价表示中的可不能仅按单字判为can。
fields.surface_relation: 关系表达本身；独立频率放入frequency，正式本体关系另行核验。
fields.correspondence: 原文明确的对象配对；拆分前逐条核对，禁止按顺序猜测配对或生成笛卡尔积。

rules.title: 对应关系与数量分开
rules.rule: 分别、respectively表示对应。先明确原文的对象与配对，必要时拆分；每条新事实均需独立原文支持，不凭词语出现直接推断配对。

rules.title: 频率与适用范围分开
rules.rule: 旧applicability或quantifier中独立、完整的频率词可以原样迁入派生frequency。仅执行程序提供的有锚点计划，保留强度、条件与附着；混合短语、冲突频率和不明附着需语义审核。

rules.title: 重复频率只保留一份
rules.rule: 仅清除surface_relation边界上与独立frequency完全相同且有原文锚点的重复词。频率仍独立保存，关系不得变空，不能用近义改写或改变条件。

rules.title: 结合语境判断模态
rules.rule: 结合完整句子、公式及上下文区分定义、等价表示与能力或可能性。可表示为不自动等于can，也不自动改成asserted；材料不足则请求上下文。

rules.title: 复合实体拆分逐条举证
rules.rule: 拆分前检查每条新事实及原配对、联合、集合语义。包含组成集合不等于包含各成员；不将集合关系自动分配到每个成员。

rules.title: 实质语义修改重新审核
rules.rule: 关系替换、指称变更、方向或极性修改、条件增删和限定强度改变都需要新版本及证据审核。字段位置本身不构成事实矛盾；必须说明丢失或改变的含义。

field_spec.normalization_policy: 确定性结果是候选版本绑定的派生表达，不覆盖原始候选、不自动准入；模型仍核验来源、限定附着与完整语义。

rules: Assign support/counter/context/irrelevant relative to the ORIGINAL candidate, including its exact surface predicate, not a corrected candidate or a true sentence considered alone.

A positive source statement may contradict the original candidate. If triple_support=contradicted, at least one actual evidence_assessment must have role=counter. Do not label that evidence support merely because it proves a proposed correction.
primary_evidence_ids contains only role=support IDs and never counter IDs. It may be empty when the original candidate is contradicted; a correction needs a separate reviewed revision.

dimensions.counterevidence.evidence_ids cites material inspected for contradiction. counterevidence_reviewed_ids instead records dismissed potential counterexamples; it never includes unresolved role=counter IDs.

Actual unresolved role=counter evidence requires counterevidence=fail/unknown, never pass. Without an actual contradiction use insufficient/unknown where appropriate; do not fabricate counterevidence for consistency.
expression_findings.check uses ONLY expression_checks. Mapping findings belong in dimensions.mapping; do not add mapping/ontology/counterevidence as expression finding checks.

Complete every required mapping field: status, relation_id, competing_relation_ids, evidence_ids and note. A known ID and compatible types alone do not establish equivalence of the exact surface predicate to that property.

Check consistency of the independently reached statuses, roles and findings BEFORE sending. Do not alter substantive judgments merely to pass validation. Return no additional top-level fields and no admission decision.
Construct dimensions.mapping as ONE nested object with relation_id and competing_relation_ids inside it; those keys are never siblings of mapping.

For each expression check, independently decide its status and findings as one unit: unresolved findings require that same dimension status=unknown; semantic_error findings require status=fail. A pass cannot coexist with an unresolved or semantic_error finding for that check.

If modality remains genuinely uncertain after reading the sentence and formula, keep the qualifier check unknown and a matching unresolved MOD-001 finding. Never automatically replace can with asserted or clear the finding to achieve a pass.

Before sending, build the actual counter-role set. If it is nonempty, counterevidence.status cannot be pass; retain fail/unknown according to the evidence. A completed search is not a no-contradiction judgment.

dispute_policy.counter_role: seek possible falsification, never mandatory opposition
dispute_policy.model_rule: Address each frozen claim target in the corresponding dimension, citing exact source evidence. Explain the specific expression, issue and effect on meaning; use expression_findings for field rules. Search for possible falsification without being required to oppose. No counterevidence found is not positive support. Preserve both observations independently. Do not settle a semantic disagreement by majority.
